Edgewise half-squared Shapley adjustment is strictly convex b² sum w_k z_k²/2, with w_k=binom(n,k)(n-k)k(k+1). For every n 2..7 the source gives exact rational primal and nonnegative dual certificate Wz=A_I^T lambda; unique global optimizer follows without relying on numerical solver. For n<=6 each z_k<=1 so p_k=a+bk(1-z_k)>=0; n7 z6=1200/929. Constrained n7 certificate with active z6=L and affine lambda(L),mu(L) nonnegative on L∈[1,1200/929] proves entire continuum, cost identity checked symbolically. Independent Fraction algebra rebuilt six KKT systems, endpoint/nonnegative analysis and polynomial penalty; no extrapolation to n>=8.

value.rationale: The finite first binding nonnegative-payment boundary is a natural economically meaningful constraint in a canonical pair-synergy game. It precisely separates a signed canonical minimum from a feasible limited-liability minimum and quantifies the necessary extra adjustment, useful without a theorem for arbitrary n.

final_claim: For v(S)=a|S|+b*binomial(|S|,2), a>=0,b>0, uniform-order one-step deferral, the unique Euclidean-closest fully voluntary signed Shapley-terminal flow is componentwise nonnegative for 2<=n<=6, but at n=7 the last entrant payment is a-1626b/929. The exact closest nonnegative flow in 0<=a<=1626b/929 has q/b=(1/2,1/2,15(2-L)/47,12(2-L)/47,20(2-L)/47,L), L=1+a/(6b), and squared adjustment penalty 21b²(1200-929L)²/43663.
limitations: Only 2<=n<=7, a>=0,b>0, uniform random entry, exact Euclidean metric and expected Shapley; does not assert impossibility of nonnegative voluntary Shapley implementation.
